pipeline.title: How It Works
pipeline.sub: Verify any Indian government document in 3 transparent, automated steps powered by neural OCR and forensic tamper detection.

auto.t3: Upload a clear scan or snap a live photo of your PAN, Aadhaar, or DL. Our system auto-detects boundaries and corrects lighting.
auto.t9: The AI kicks in. It extracts text via OCR, maps facial zones, and runs Error Level Analysis (ELA) to detect tampering pixels.
auto.t15: The extracted data is verified against known cryptographic constraints, generating a final tamper risk score and authenticity badge.
auto.t21: PramaanSetu provides organizations with banking-grade tools to verify Indian government identities. Build trust internally and protect platforms against fraud.
auto.t25: Discover the core infrastructure that powers millions of identity verifications.
auto.t27: All traffic is 256-bit encrypted. Uploaded documents are destroyed immediately after verification. No logs.
auto.t29: Optimized exclusively for authenticating UIDAI Aadhaar, NSDL PAN, and Parivahan Driving Licences.
auto.t31: Integrate identity forensics straight into your app. Lightweight REST API with comprehensive documentation.
auto.t33: Start securing your platform today with PramaanSetu’s precise verification engine.

img.heroDesc: An enterprise-grade, AI-powered platform for verifying the authenticity of Indian identity documents like PAN Card, Driving Licence, Aadhaar and more. Fast, secure and tamper-proof.
img.step1Desc: Drag & drop Aadhaar, PAN, DL, or Passport in PDF/JPG format. High-precision Tesseract OCR auto-detects fields, names, DOB, and document numbers.
img.step2Desc: Cross-matches signed QR matrix payload against visual text, runs checksum algorithms, and applies Error Level Analysis (ELA) to detect image alteration.
img.step3Desc: Generates a 0–100% Trust Score in seconds with an itemized risk breakdown, forensic flags, and an authoritative compliance summary.
img.showcaseTitle: Interactive Before vs After: Tamper Detection Showcase
img.showcaseSub: Drag the interactive slider below to reveal how PramaanSetu's neural forensic pipeline detects altered fonts, forged dates of birth, and manipulated pixel compression that bypass standard visual checks.
img.f1D: Detects altered digits spliced in different typography.
img.f2D: Spots resampled borders where a new photo was pasted.
img.f3D: Verifies visual text against digitally signed payload.
img.entSub: Designed for high-scale, zero-trust environments requiring instant verification compliance and defense against synthetic identity fraud.
img.kycSub: Automated API verification across NSDL, UIDAI & RBI Compliance
img.kycDesc: Streamline savings accounts, credit cards, and digital loan approvals in under 3 seconds. PramaanSetu eliminates synthetic identity fraud, forged salary slips, and altered PAN cards before onboarding.

modal.title: PramaanSetu India Demo Walkthrough
modal.subtitle: PramaanSetu India executes a 7-stage automated pipeline:
modal.s2D: Optical extraction of PAN, DL, DOB, and Names.
modal.s3D: Algorithmic validation (PAN regex, DL State codes).
modal.s4D: Extracts embedded signed payload and compares with visual OCR.
modal.s5D: Scans pixel compression anomalies to detect alterations.
modal.s6D: Simulates lookup against DigiLocker, NSDL & Parivahan API.
modal.s7D: Computes 0-100 authenticity score with penalty breakdown.
